summary: Pre-push patch-coverage hook reuses machine verify's coverage data on an exact tree match (amends DEC-0282)

options.description: Skip the vitest run and recompute the patch gate from verify's coverage files, only when head tree, origin/main base sha and the clean flag match and the coverage files are no older than the record; otherwise run as today
Skip both the run and the gate on a passing verify record
Keep running the coverage suites on every push (DEC-0282 unchanged)
Remove the pre-push copy and rely on verify plus CI

body: Lever 3 of the duplicate-test-run work. Once AISDLC-1185 lands, machine verify runs each touched package under test:coverage and the patch gate. The pre-push hook (DEC-0282) then repeats both on the same tree. CI's patch gate stays the merge block (AISDLC-726); the hook is an early copy.
